Expect him at or slightly below ETR's number.

name: Ace Bailey
blurb: Trailing: 3 unders (-7 to -10), one over (+8) and an in-line +4 last time. The unders came on cold or light shooting (3-7, 2-8, 3-11), twice on 23-24 minutes, one of those in a 25-point win; the -10 was against our usual with no ETR number. Back to 33 minutes last time; expect his number if that holds.

name: Brice Sensabaugh
blurb: Minutes are up, 26 a game against a usual 19 and 26-35 in four of five, and that's the sticky part. The +39 was a 40-point, 16-21 outlier in a 25-point win, the +10 was against our usual with no ETR number, and the one under was 14 minutes with 5 turnovers when ETR had him above his usual (26 vs 20). If the minutes hold, expect him at or a bit over his low-20s number.

name: Darryn Peterson
blurb: Trailing: 3 unders in the last four, by 14 to 23, around a +16 on 10 rebounds and 8 assists. Two misses came on cut minutes (19 and 25 against a usual 31) and the shooting was cold in two (3-10, 3-9). He's averaging 28 minutes; if that holds, expect him under his number.

name: Isaiah Collier
blurb: In line all five, never more than 5 off ETR, on minutes 12-24 around a usual 16. His best night (31.5) came on 24 minutes with Markkanen out, the low on 12 minutes in a 15-point blowout. No trend; expect his number.

name: Jaxson Hayes
blurb: Over by 11 in each of his last two, on 25 and 28 minutes, with his one under on 17 minutes through 4 fouls. The overs came on noise: 2 steals and 2 blocks, then 7-8 shooting with 14 rebounds. Minutes have swung 13-30 around a usual 24 with no role change, so expect his number with real variance.

name: Josh Green
blurb: Over in his last two (+16, +10) on 28 and 29 minutes, after 13-15 minutes with an under and two in-line nights. The minutes are the real change; the size of the overs also leaned on 2 steals and a block both nights and 4-4 shooting. ETR is still around 10-12, so if the 28-29 minutes hold he should keep beating it.

name: Josh Okogie
blurb: Trending down: two overs early, including a +8 measured against our usual since ETR had no number (27 minutes, 3 steals), then -12 on 15 minutes and an in-line -5 on 17. Minutes 15-27, 21 a game against a usual 21, so no lasting role change, and the overs leaned on steals and assists. Expect his mid-teens number with a low floor.

name: Keyonte George
blurb: Mixed (2 over, 3 under), with shooting the main driver: 5-17 and 4-17 on two unders, 30 on 10-17 in the +15. The latest under (-12) came on 26 minutes with ETR above his usual (42 vs 38). Minutes 26-39 around a usual 34, no trend; expect his number with a wide range.

name: Kyle Filipowski
blurb: Spot minutes (8-15), over once, under once, in line twice. Not a draftable role until the minutes settle.

name: Lauri Markkanen
blurb: Never under: over twice (31 minutes, then 39) and in line on 8-15 from three last time. Minutes 29-39 against a usual 30. He's at or above his number.

name: Mo Bamba
blurb: Mixed: 1 over, 2 in line and 2 under. Minutes went 36, 31, 23, 20, then 23 against a usual 20, so the role is bigger than his average says. ETR has had him above his usual, so it's already pricing a bigger role.

name: Svi Mykhailiuk
blurb: Never under: 3 over, 2 in line, on 28-34 minutes in the last four against a usual 20. ETR has stayed between 11.4 and 16.3, so the minutes are the sticky edge; the +30 (39 points, 10-15 from three) is shooting noise on top. Expect him to beat his number while the minutes hold.

name: AJ Dybantsa
blurb: Beating his number: three overs and two in line, never under, with minutes at his usual 34-35. Assists above his rate in two of five (6 against about 2) and 12 rebounds once. Expect his number or better.

name: Alex Sarr
blurb: Mixed: 2 over, 1 in line, 2 under, with minutes 20-31 against a usual 28. The unders came on cold shooting (2-9) and 20 minutes; the latest over (32.8) was when ETR had him below his usual. Expect his number with a wide range.

name: Anthony Davis
blurb: Trailing: under in three of five, with minutes steady at 31-35. Rebounds drove the unders (4 and 7, against about 11 for his minutes), which tends to be noise; the 50.8 and 50.7 show the number is right on his good nights. Expect his number.

name: Bilal Coulibaly
blurb: In line with ETR all five games, never more than 3 off, with minutes 16-26 (usual 24). Expect high teens.

name: Bub Carrington
blurb: Never over: three in line and two unders, both zeros, on 10 minutes and then 2 minutes in a 16-point blowout. Minutes 2-23, 14 a game against a usual 18, and ETR has already had him below his usual (10 vs 15). The role is shrinking; expect at or under a number around 9-13, with a zero floor.

name: Deandre Ayton
blurb: Mixed: 1 over, 2 in line, 2 under, with minutes 7-24 (usual 15). The over (28.7) was 23 minutes with 11 rebounds; the unders were a 7-minute blowout and a night ETR had him above his usual. Expect low teens.

name: Khris Middleton
blurb: A real role now: minutes 18-28 in all five, far above a usual 8. He's been in line or over ETR's single-digit-to-low-teens numbers, never under. Expect about 12 at these minutes.

name: Kyshawn George
blurb: In line with ETR all five games, never more than 3 off, with minutes 30-40 (usual 35). Expect his number.

name: Trae Young
blurb: Never over: three in line and two under, with minutes down (31 a game against a usual 34). Two blowouts cut his minutes (26 and 28) and cold shooting runs through the stretch (0-5, 2-9). Expect a bit under his number until the shot and minutes come back.

name: Tre Johnson
blurb: Minutes have fallen: 8 and 4 in two games, then 15, against a usual 21. He was under both short nights and in line when ETR priced him low (7.6). Expect a small number until the minutes return.

name: Will Riley
blurb: A fringe role: 1, 5 and 20 minutes in his three games, in line each time against ETR's low numbers. Expect little unless the minutes stick.
